video.subject_count.evidence: [director·claude] I counted people in all 84 cells of image 1, from 00:00:00.000 to 00:00:20.750. Every cell has the same two women and no one else. Riley sits on the left with long black hair down. Helvia sits on the right with her hair up in a bun. Both are on the stone bench along the west wall the whole time, with their positions and sizes unchanged. No one appears or disappears, and there is no duplicate of either person.

video.no_text.evidence: [director·claude·审稿兜底，待机检工具] Ignoring the yellow timecode in each cell's top-left corner, I checked image 1 from 0.000 to 20.750. The light streaks at the bottom-right of the floor are reflections off the wet floor, not text.
